**Parlance 0.2.0 for desktop: Parlance is the general dictation app again.**

- Parlance and Hebrish are now separate apps that can be installed side by side. Parlance offers every model; Hebrish (Hebrish-ASR/Hebrish-Dictation) is for the English-Hebrew code-switching model.
- **Ubuntu 26.04**: `sudo apt install ./parlance_0.2.0-1_amd64.deb`. If you installed **Hebrish 0.1.1 or 0.1.2** (package `parlance`), this upgrades it and keeps its settings and models. Default hotkey F13; Hebrish's is F14.
- **Windows** (untested on real hardware): `Parlance-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip`. Unzip it and run `Parlance.exe`. It is unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn you.
- Also: the import from Voice To Hebrish carries over transcript history.
